labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE, no X: FS-UAE (github.com/Wnt/fs-uae, branch kernel-hive/integrated) runs on the host headless (no DISPLAY, no GL). Frames publish into SH_SHM_PATH (drawshm-format shm), keys and the absolute pointer (mousehack) ride the ctlsock (SH_MAMECTL_SOCK) with the shared streamhost/stations/fsuae-native/amiga.keymap, audio into SH_AUDIO_FIFO. No QEMU/QMP, no guest Linux, no exec channel, no Xvfb/XTEST. Reset=relaunch: fresh work HDF copied from disk/amigaos35-system.hdf.golden on every launch, cold boot (~10s to desktop, measured on the rig), no statefile — UAE savestates were already rejected for this station (docs/guests/amigaos35.md), and the faster cold boot removes the reason to revisit that. Launcher stations/fsuae-native/x11-runtime.sh (shared with a1000/a3000/amix).

museum.blurb: The classic Amiga's 1999 swan song: five years after Commodore died, a fan-driven Amiga Inc shipped one last 68k AmigaOS with GlowIcons, CD-ROM support and a bundled web suite — booting a real 68040 big-box with the AWeb II browser two clicks away.
museum.notes: Host-native without X (converted 2026-09-09, repo-side): FS-UAE (fork github.com/Wnt/fs-uae, branch kernel-hive/integrated; A4000/040 model, AGA-era 68040, Kickstart 3.1 r40.068) runs headless, publishing shm frames and taking ctlsock keys/pointer directly via the shared launcher stations/fsuae-native/x11-runtime.sh -- no Xvfb, no XTEST. AGA chipset screen (640x512 laced, 64 colours) rather than RTG, as before. Kickstart 3.1 r40.068 + OS 3.5 CD media staged in /data/assets-staging/amigaos35 (preservation-class, never committed). Reset = relaunch: a cold boot of a fresh work HDF copied from the golden, rig-measured at ~10s to desktop (was ~85s under Xvfb with a rejected savestate path). Retronet web plane unchanged: bsdsocket inside netns rn-amigaos35 via rn-netns.sh, now invoked by the shared launcher's FSUAE_NATIVE_NET=bsdsocket/FSUAE_NATIVE_NETNS knobs. Distinct from the amiga (A500 / 1.3 bridge) and aros (x86 reimplementation) tiles; archetype beige-tower-crt (ideal: an A4000 big-box tower). See docs/guests/amigaos35.md.

network.note: Retronet web plane via a NETNS CAGE: FS-UAE has no tap/pcap backend, so its bsdsocket_library host sockets are opened inside netns rn-amigaos35, whose only interface is the guest end of veth amiga35-h/amiga35-g; the host end is enslaved to vmbr-rn (no uplink). Static 10.99.0.26 (reservation kept in RETRONET_DHCP_RESERVATIONS), MAC per the fleet scheme in gitignored local.env (RN_AMIGAOS35_MAC), no default route in the netns, fail-closed AMIGAOS35RN-IN chain above RETRONET-IN. Containment proven from inside the cage: gateway 10.99.0.2 serves DNS+HTTP, 10.99.0.1 drops 100%, 1.1.1.1 unroutable at the stack. The shared launcher (stations/fsuae-native/x11-runtime.sh) runs rn-netns.sh up on every start via FSUAE_NATIVE_NET=bsdsocket/FSUAE_NATIVE_NETNS=rn-amigaos35, re-verifying its own rules. See docs/lab/retronet/WEB-STATION-amigaos35.md.
